name: LOVATO FFL700DP diesel fire-pump controller
summary: Operator controller for a diesel-engine fire-pump control panel.
description: Locate the display and operator controls on the panel face, then coordinate rear connectors and engine-interface wiring. The controller is one component of the complete fire-pump panel.
Use the linked manufacturer CAD for dimensions and the exact selected configuration. The downloadable illustration here is original educational geometry, unitless and not to scale.
readingNotes: Identify the exact FFL700DP version and use its installation documentation for panel integration. Do not infer system approval from a mechanical CAD model.
A controller outline is not the enclosure, battery chargers or complete approved fire-pump control assembly.
drawingChecklist: Use the exact faceplate and cutout drawing.
Reserve rear terminal and service access.
Cross-reference engine, battery and remote alarm interfaces.
